Spencer PLC Clinic

Dear Colleague,

I saw Ryan Barry in consultation on January 25, 2025. His blood pressure was 138/69, and his weight was 253 pounds.

Regarding Ryan's Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA), which occurred 2.4 years ago, he is currently in a controlled status. There are no medications being prescribed for this condition.

For his chronic back pain and spine issues, Ryan is on chronic opioid and benzodiazepine therapy, which are currently controlling his symptoms. His medication regimen includes naproxen 500 mg.

Ryan also has Rheumatoid arthritis, which is being managed with biologic therapy. His current medications for this condition are etanercept 50 mg injection and methotrexate 2.5 mg. is a liver transplant recipient, having received his transplant 6 years ago. His immunosuppressive therapy includes sirolimus 1 mg, and his remains controlled.

Additionally, Ryan has been diagnosed with glaucoma and is being treated with latanoprost 0.005% and timolol ophthalmic 0.5%, both of which are effectively controlling his condition.

Impression and recommendations remain as stated above. 

Please note that Ryan has been non-compliant with his medication regimen and has missed follow-up appointments on two occasions.

Social history reveals that Ryan is a former smoker, having smoked 10 cigarettes a day until he quit in September 2019. He consumes approximately 12 alcoholic drinks per week.

Thank you for this referral.

Sincerely,
Dr. Richard Bowman
